info.title: SMART SPACE backend
info.description: Local-first AI file manager API. All endpoints except GET /api/v1/health need `Authorization: Bearer <SS_TOKEN>`. Errors: `{error: {code, message, details}}`.

post.summary: Graceful stop (flush DB, stop llama-server and watcher)

schema.title: Response Catalog Api V1 Models Catalog Get

get.summary: SSE: queued, progress, completed, failed, cancelled

post.summary: Start llama-server with the active LLM (poll /models/llm/status)
Activate for its role; embedding changes need confirm_reindex (else 409 REINDEX_REQUIRED)

delete.summary: Delete model files (not the active model)

schema.title: Response Get Workspace Api V1 Workspace Get

put.summary: Set the root folder; 409 WORKSPACE_EXISTS for another path unless replace=true

delete.summary: Unlink the workspace and delete the whole index

schema.title: Response Exclusions Api V1 Workspace Exclusions Get

post.summary: Add a glob (relative to the root); matching files are removed from the index

schema.title: Response Tree Api V1 Files Tree Get

get.summary: Downscaled JPEG (max 1024 px) for images and PDF pages

put.summary: Replace the user tags of a file

delete.summary: Remove this file's derived data; the row becomes skipped/excluded

post.summary: Full scan + queue all pending files

get.summary: Files in error or skipped, with reason
SSE: state_changed, progress, file_indexed, file_error, file_skipped, file_removed, summary_done, summary_failed

post.summary: Hybrid search. mode=quick: top 6 files, short snippet, no summary. Queries are not stored.
Ask a question. SSE stream: meta, files, token*, sources, done (or error)
Delete app-created data only (never your files). confirm must be true

get.summary: JSON of summaries, tags and doc types (no file content)

schema.title: Response Get Settings Api V1 Settings Get

put.summary: Partial update; unknown keys or wrong types -> 422

schema.title: Response Put Settings Api V1 Settings Put

local_copy.title: Local Copy
local_copy.description: Folder of a copy already on this PC (reused instead of downloading); null if none

source.title: Source
source.description: "network", or "local" while a copy already on this PC is verified and installed

best_gpu.description: The usable GPU with the most VRAM (used for the tier and the language model); null if none is usable

local_copy.title: Local Copy
local_copy.description: Folder of a copy already on this PC; POST /models/{id}/download then installs it without downloading

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime, on file mtime

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Partial update. Unknown keys and wrong types are rejected (422 VALIDATION_ERROR).

text.title: Text
text.description: HTML-escaped text; matched terms wrapped in <mark>
